signals.usability_note: Clear daytime street-level view of a two-story colonial home with a paver driveway and front lawn.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Trimmed round shrubs and mulch beds along the driveway look tidy, but there is no crew, equipment, or other clear sign of professional service.

signals.notes: The two-car garage is open with items stored inside, and a dark SUV and a white SUV are parked on the paver driveway; the home looks well maintained with no visible signs of activity.
